findings.reason: The proof assigns all singular Pθ₂ mass s to the upper tail in step 3.1 and says the lower-tail test is zero on that mass in step 4.1. MLR only puts that mass above the Pθ₁ support, not above an arbitrary c. For example, Pθ₁=δ₀ and Pθ₂=δ₁ with T(x)=x have MLR under counting measure; at c=2, both assertions fail. The statement remains valid: use the support ordering to bound the singular contribution below by s Eθ₁φ⁺ and above by s Eθ₁φ⁻, respectively.
